asr_text: 11 labs agent -rewarding your legal disclosure. A say -node speaks one message at a specific point, then moves on. Two modes prompt lets the LLM write it. Literal speaks your exact text. For a legal disclosure, Literal is the safe choice. You can add a translation for each configured language. Typical uses, greetings, legal disclosures, and confirmations read back to users. Save this and watch the full lesson in episode 23.
